leiras: Ikontechnika-szótár. Az 5 ikonstílus ügyfelenként ebből áll össze: technika (ez a fájl) + az ügyfél tárgyi világából egy csavar (anyag, nézőpont, rajzmód). Öt KÜLÖNBÖZŐ családból válassz, és a 'regi' jelölésű (a régi fix készletből ismert) technikákból legfeljebb egyet. A prompt angol (a képmodell angolul pontosabb); a {primary} {accent} {accent2} {ink} {paper} helyére az ikon-spec.json 'szinek' mezője kerül. A k5 a karakter-illeszkedés (0-3), az ax a formanyelvi tengelyek (0..1: organikus, puha, harsany, kortars, kezi).

csaladok.nyomat: nyomott grafika (linó, riso, cianotípia, pecsét, szita)
csaladok.anyag: anyag és tárgy (agyag, kerámia, papír, textil, fa, üveg, zománc)

technikak.prompt: Minimal monoline icon: uniform medium-weight {ink} strokes with rounded caps and joins, no fills, generous negative space, precise and calm.

Graphite pencil sketch icon: soft {ink} pencil lines with light cross-hatching for shadows, slightly uneven strokes, like a designer's quick study in a sketchbook, a single pale wash of {primary} in one area.
Ink brush icon: confident calligraphic brush strokes in {ink} with dry-brush texture at the edges, varying line weight, one small flat accent in {accent}.

Technical plan-view icon drawn like an architect's or engineer's drawing seen from above: thin precise {ink} lines, small dimension ticks, dotted guide circles, a few areas hatched in {primary}, clean drafting style.
Fine engraving / etching style icon: dense parallel hatching and cross-hatching lines in {ink}, like a 19th-century scientific plate, with a subtle hand-tinted wash of {primary} and {accent}.

Monoline line-art icon: uniform {ink} strokes with rounded caps, plus two flat colour blobs in {accent} and {primary} slightly offset behind the drawing like a misregistered print. Editorial, lots of white space.
Flat vector icon built from simple rounded geometric shapes, solid fills in {primary}, {accent} and {accent2}, tiny {ink} details, no outlines, no gradients, no 3D.
Layered cut-paper icon: three or four stacked paper layers in {primary}, {accent}, {accent2} and {paper}, crisp hand-cut edges, tiny soft shadows between layers, subtle paper fibre texture.
Mosaic icon made of small irregular hand-cut tiles in {primary}, {accent}, {accent2} and {paper}, thin light grout lines between the tiles, flat frontal view.
Bauhaus-style abstract icon built only from circles, half-circles, quarter-circles and rectangles in {primary}, {accent} and {accent2}, flat, bold, balanced asymmetric composition.
Spray-paint stencil icon: bold simplified shapes with visible stencil bridges, mostly {primary} with a second {accent} layer, slight overspray dots at the edges.
Loose watercolour icon: transparent washes of {primary} and {accent} with soft bleeding edges and pigment granulation, a few fine {ink} pencil contour lines.
Opaque gouache painting icon: flat matte brushy fills in {primary}, {accent} and {accent2}, visible brush strokes, mid-century picture-book feel, simple shapes.
Soft pastel chalk icon: grainy chalky strokes in {primary}, {accent} and {accent2}, smudged soft edges, visible paper tooth texture.
Wax crayon drawing icon: waxy textured strokes in {ink} for the outline and {primary}, {accent} fills that slightly miss the lines, warm and careful like a good children's book.
Linocut print icon: bold carved shapes in {ink} with white gouge marks, one {primary} colour layer slightly misregistered, hand-printed ink texture.
Two-colour risograph print icon: bold simple forms in {primary} and {accent} inks only, visible grain and slight misregistration, flat, no gradients.

Cyanotype photogram icon: a small square cyanotype print with soft deckled paper edges, the object appears as a crisp white and pale-blue silhouette with fine translucent details on deep Prussian blue, gentle sun-print texture.
Rubber stamp impression icon: {primary} ink with uneven coverage, worn edges and small gaps, the object inside a simple circular or rectangular stamp frame.
Vintage screen-print poster icon: three flat inks {primary}, {accent} and {ink}, halftone dot shading in one area, slightly faded, 1960s travel-poster simplicity.
Soft 3D clay icon: rounded chunky matte shapes, gentle studio light from the top left, soft ambient occlusion, colours {primary}, {accent} and {accent2}. No harsh reflections, no floor.
Glazed ceramic icon: the object as a small hand-made ceramic piece with glossy {primary} glaze pooling at the edges and {accent} underglaze details, gentle soft studio light, no floor.

Pressed-botanical collage icon: the object composed of real-looking pressed and dried leaves, petals and grass blades in {primary}, {accent} and dried straw tones, flat and slightly translucent, held by one tiny strip of paper tape.
Embroidered patch icon: satin-stitch and running-stitch threads in {primary}, {accent} and {accent2} on a small round fabric patch, visible thread texture and tiny stitch holes.
Wood marquetry icon: the object inlaid from light and dark wood veneers with a few pieces stained {primary} and {accent}, visible wood grain, flat frontal view, fine joints.
Origami icon: the object folded from paper, crisp faceted folds in light and dark shades of {primary} and {accent}, soft directional light, clean edges.
Stained glass icon: coloured glass segments in {primary}, {accent} and {accent2} with subtle light variation, separated by dark {ink} lead lines, simple symmetrical composition.
Hard enamel pin icon: polished gold metal outlines with flat {primary}, {accent} and {accent2} enamel fills, a tiny highlight shine, die-struck clean edges.
Die-cut sticker illustration: flat illustration in {primary}, {accent} and {accent2} with a thick white outline around the whole object and a subtle soft shadow under the sticker. Playful, no gloss.
Isometric icon: the object in true 30-degree isometric projection, flat shaded faces in light, mid and dark tones of {primary} with {accent} details, crisp edges, no outlines.
Pixel-art icon on a 32x32 grid: crisp square pixels, limited palette of {primary}, {accent}, {accent2} and {ink}, no anti-aliasing.
Neon sign icon: the object drawn as glowing bent glass tubes in {accent} and {primary} with a soft outer glow, simple continuous lines, as if on a dark wall (but keep the background transparent).
